properties.name: normalized
properties.description: If valid, this holds the normalized expression filter text.  Otherwise, this will be a NOT_SET String.

properties.name: acdSkills
properties.description: If valid, the items in this collection will be ACD Skills referenced by the filter.  Otherwise, this will be an empty collection.

properties.name: languageSkills
properties.description: If valid, the items in this collection will be Language Skills referenced by the filter.  Otherwise, this will be an empty collection.

properties.name: errors
properties.description: If invalid, the items in this collection will contain error information about the input filter String.

properties.name: type
properties.description: A non-empty String that contains the type or category of the issue.

properties.name: message
properties.description: A non-localized message for the issue. The String may be empty or NOT_SET.
